title: 第6080章 大比第一太子之位第6079章 君王朝
lines: 大比大比第一？太子之位？（第22页）包括，叶寒在内。
“想必诸位自身也等不及了。”
“我们君王朝众生，也想要知晓，那个最终的结果。”
老者在随后笑了笑，再度开口道：“按照规矩，排名一千至五百名，获封地侯，五百至三百名，获封天侯。”
顿了顿，老者继续道：“三百至一百名，获封天级战将，而百名以内，则为神侯。”
叶寒意外。
这君王朝内，朝廷之中的王侯级别划分，约莫是受了黄金神国的影响？居然也是地侯、天侯、神侯？“至于，诸位最关心的太子之位，便由……。”
老者声音滚滚，再度开口。
这一刹。
人群之中，那狱无双就踏出一步，神情傲然，黑袍猎猎，风采绝代。
“恭喜无双少爷！”
四面八方，无数的声音已然响起，此地变得重新喧闹起来。
狱无双略微点头，算是回应着四周恭维的众人。
自己的排名如何，其实上几乎不需要等待最后的结果。
在刚才短短一刻钟内，狱无双就已经知晓了此次天意大比中，其他一些竞争者的情况，都无法和自己相比。
但这世上的事情……往往充满了意外。
那老者的声音，紧接着响彻乾坤：“太子之位，便由叶无忌入位！”
皇城前方，生灵无数。
本是喧闹嘈杂至极。
然而这一刹那，时间和空间，都仿佛停止了流逝。
天地间的一切定格在了这一瞬之间。
无数的生灵，全部瞪大了眼瞳。
死死凝聚在了那老者的身上。
四周陷入死一般的寂静。
便是那狱无双……脸上的笑容，戛然而止，凝固在了那里。
然后，逐渐变得难看至极。
“什么？”
“叶无忌？”
“大人，是不是口误了？”
狱无双身侧，一名女子主动开口。
“自然是没有错的！”
“未来，我们君王朝的太子，便是叶无忌！”
content_en:
,,!
Dabi Dabi first? The position of prince? (Page 22) Including Ye Han.
"You must not be able to wait any longer."
"We, the king and the sentient beings, also want to know the final result."
The old man then smiled and spoke again: "According to the rules, those ranked between 1,000 and 500 will be granted the title of Land Marquis, and those ranked between 500 and 300 will be granted the title of Heavenly Marquis."
After a pause, the old man continued: "Three hundred to one hundred people will be awarded the title of heavenly generals, and those who are less than one hundred will be awarded the title of divine princes."
Ye Han was surprised.
Could it be that the hierarchy of princes in this dynasty was influenced by the Golden Kingdom? He is also a Marquis of Earth, Heaven, and God? "As for the position of the crown prince that you are most concerned about, it is decided by..."
The old man's voice was rolling and he spoke again.
This moment.
Among the crowd, Jie Wushuang took a step forward, with an arrogant look on his face, wearing a black robe and unrivaled elegance.
"Congratulations, Master Wushuang!"
Countless voices sounded from all directions, and the place became noisy again.
"Yeah!"
Ji Wushuang nodded slightly in response to the compliments from everyone around him.
How is your ranking? In fact, there is almost no need to wait for the final results.
In just a quarter of an hour, Jie Wushuang already knew that the conditions of other competitors in this Providence Competition were incomparable to his own.
But things in this world... are often full of surprises.
The old man's voice resounded throughout the universe: "The position of Prince will be taken by Ye Wuji!"
In front of the imperial city, there are countless creatures.
It was extremely noisy.
However, at this moment, time and space seemed to have stopped passing.
Everything between heaven and earth was frozen in this moment.
Countless creatures all had their eyes widened.
Everything was concentrated on the old man's body.
There was deathly silence all around.
It was that Jie Wushuang...the smile on his face stopped suddenly and froze there.
Then, it gradually became extremely ugly.
"What?"
"Ye Wuji?"
"Sir, did you make a mistake?"
Beside Jing Wushuang, a woman took the initiative to speak.
"Of course there is nothing wrong with it!"
"In the future, the prince of our dynasty will be Ye Wuji!"
